(() => { const source=planets.find(p=>p.owner===PLAYER); const target=planets.find(p=>p.owner===NEUTRAL); if(!source||!target)throw Error('No battlefield'); const c=document.querySelector('#canvas'); c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true,clientX:source.x*battleScale,clientY:source.y*battleScale}));c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup',{bubbles:true,clientX:source.x*battleScale,clientY:source.y*battleScale}));c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true,clientX:target.x*battleScale,clientY:target.y*battleScale}));c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup',{bubbles:true,clientX:target.x*battleScale,clientY:target.y*battleScale})); })()

(() => { for(let i=0;i<planets.length;i++){const p=planets[i],r=(p.size+10)*battleScale,x=p.x*battleScale,y=p.y*battleScale;if(x-r<0||x+r>innerWidth||y-r<arenaTop*battleScale||y+r>arenaBottom*battleScale)throw Error('Planet is outside its clear field');for(let j=0;j<i;j++){const q=planets[j];if((Math.hypot(p.x-q.x,p.y-q.y)-p.size-q.size-20)*battleScale<15.9)throw Error('Planet footprint gap is below 16px');}} })()
